source_checks.checked: Theorem 2.4 page 296, odd prime-power convention, t=1 exception; authors survey used because original publisher and institutional pages were inaccessible

derivation: For odd prime power q>=5, ceil(q/4)>=2 so t=1 is admissible. Put n=q²-1, r(n)=q²+q. Then 2n+1-r(n)=q²-q-1. Cor7 yields lower q²-1. Since (q-1)²<q²-q-2<q², Cor3 yields upper q².
graph_equivalence: r(N-d)>N iff a C4-free graph of order N has minimum degree >=d. For N<d² the neighbor-layer bound N>=1+deg(v)(d-1) forces d-regularity.
